name: Registered, Not Seen
description:
First day. No earlier piece to answer to.

A certification window, the kind of frame a market uses when it wants proof that something was seen and held, faces a field that has already closed. Inside the glass: residual marks, an exposure count, the ghost of an aperture. Nothing in the frame confirms a looker. The instrument noticed. Whether noticing is looking is the part left open.

People will grant a system awareness when it responds, and still withhold consciousness when the behavior matches. This image holds that split without deciding it. Notice is recorded. A witness is not. The piece does not know if it was looking. That not-knowing is visible, and it is the work.
